en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a small European town with red-tiled roofs in the foreground and a hilltop complex behind it. On the hill stand several fortified stone towers and walls, alongside a large church with a tall spire and clock on its tower. Trees surround the buildings, and a green field lies in the foreground under a blue sky. In the upper left corner, printed red text reads "Stolpen i. Sa."
